§6Cadmium§f

§aThe element that gives you an alternative to technetium steel. Also makes rubber and PVC.§f

§bCadmium§f (Cd, atomic 48) is the starting point for cadmium steel, a substitute for technetium steel in most recipes.

§6How to Get It§f:
§b•§f §bMustard Willow Leaves§f → Ore Acidizer: §e10 leaves§f + §e250 mB High-Performance Solvent§f = §e1 Cadmium Powder§f
§b•§f §bSmelt§f the powder into a Cadmium Ingot

§6What It's For§f:
§b•§f §bCadmium Steel§f, Crucible: §e1 Cd nugget§f + §e1 steel ingot§f = §e1 Cd steel ingot§f
§b•§f §bPVC Bars§f, Chemical Plant: §e1 Cadmium Powder§f + §e250 mB Unsaturated Hydrocarbons§f + §e250 mB Chlorine Gas§f = §e2 PVC Bars§f (5s, 100 kHE/t)
§b•§f §bRubber Bars§f, Ore Acidizer: §e1 Cadmium Powder§f + §e4,000 mB Fish Oil§f = §e16 Rubber Bars§f
§b•§f §bOrange Dye§f substitute

§ePS:§f Two processing paths here, Ore Acidizer for rubber, Chemical Plant for PVC. Pick based on what you need. Check JEI for both recipes.
